definitions.explanation: Describing a situation where two sides are evenly matched with no advantage to either, often used for competitions, negotiations, or odds.
A quantity representing five out of ten in the traditional Japanese counting system, equivalent to half or 50 percent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{勝負|しょうぶ}→勝負：01437_shoubu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五分五分|ごぶごぶ}だ。
⟦{両者|りょうしゃ}→両者：11357_ryousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五分|ごぶ}だ。
{五分|ごぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{交渉|こうしょう}する→交渉する：17189_koushousuru⟧。
⟦{成功|せいこう}する→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧⟦{確率|かくりつ}→確率：00159_kakuritsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五分|ごぶ}だ。
examples.english: The probability of success is fifty percent.

examples.japanese: {五分|ごぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{利益|りえき}を{得|え}る→利益を得る：30182_riekiwoeru⟧。
examples.english: To earn a fifty percent profit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五分五分|ごぶごぶ}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I was told the chance of passing was fifty-fifty.

notes:
Read as ごぶ, not ごふん (which is the time expression for five minutes). Based on the traditional system where 10 {分|ぶ} = 1 whole, so {五分|ごぶ} literally means five out of ten, or 50%. Most commonly used in the reduplicated form {五分五分|ごぶごぶ} to mean fifty-fifty or even odds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {五分五分|ごぶごぶ}: fifty-fifty, even odds
- {五分|ごぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧: equal terms
- {五分|ごぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{渡|わた}り{合|あ}う: to hold one's own, fight on equal terms
- {五分|ごぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧: an even fight

NOTE ON READING:
- {五分|ごぶ}: five parts, even — traditional counting unit
- {五分|ごふん}: five minutes — the time expression (separate entry)
